text: Astronomy examines celestial objects and phenomena, yielding many remarkable findings. Craters represent one notable wonder within these cosmic sights. Impacts from asteroids or comets striking planets generate such depressions, exposing a turbulent past for our solar system. The Marecrater on the Moon serves as an illustration; its large, bowl-like form provides data regarding lunar formation and development. In addition to craters, scientists investigate other orbital bodies, including the elliptical trajectories of planets circling the Sun and the intricate movements of asteroids and comets within the Kuiper Belt.
